content:
A lightweight recording booth that can travel between community events. The
plan borrows the welcoming format of the
[Listening Garden](/note/projects/listening_garden/listening_garden) and the consent
model from the [Neighborhood Atlas](/note/projects/neighborhood_atlas/neighborhood_atlas).

The project remains planned until funding and accessibility review are complete.

occurrences.context: Her reminder that “a map is an invitation, not an inventory” shaped Design principles and the Mobile Story Booth.
Taylor is reviewing the early proposal for the Mobile Story Booth.

- People: Alex, Amara, and the full People section - Projects: active, planned, completed, and idea - Tasks: todo, in progress, blocked, and done records with subtasks and deadlines - Calendar: social and work events, a weekly series, project links, and a cross-midnight event
The earlier Listening Garden is complete, and the Mobile Story Booth is waiting for its next planning window.
That lesson now shapes the Neighborhood Atlas and the proposed Mobile Story Booth.
